box.text:
1. Make a sound and click morphcapture A.
2. Change the synth and click morphcapture B.
3. Enter seconds, then click morphto A or morphto B.
A/B dump messages are passive: clicking one stages it; it never recalls or starts audio.
Capture all controls, hidden memories, function curves and stores in A.
Capture a second complete state in B.
Set the duration to ten seconds. Range: 0–3600 seconds.
Morph from the current sound to B over ten seconds.
Morph from the current sound to A over five seconds.
Pause the morph, not audio playback.
Hold the current intermediate model; return to manual editing.
Finish now; ordinary audio-rate smoothing still applies.
Copy slot A into the ordinary full-dump output message.

Direct dump transition: morph SECONDS preset VERSION CHECKSUM CHUNKS…
Example: place [prepend morph 8] after a full preset message, then send to Synth_Control_v23. The old dump is the source only after recall; otherwise the source is the current live synth.

Playback continues. Updated ADSR curves apply at the next trigger or loop boundary. Menus/switches and dormant stores commit at the end. No DSP or note is started. Full v21 dumps are accepted; low-CPU dumps are not. Normal preset recall still mutes/stops; use morph commands for transitions. Save edited A/B message boxes in your patch to keep them after closing.

hint.value: Store the complete current synth state in slot A without recalling or stopping audio.

annotation.value: Store the complete current synth state in slot A without recalling or stopping audio.

hint.value: Morph from the current complete state to A using the duration in seconds.

annotation.value: Morph from the current complete state to A using the duration in seconds.

hint.value: Morph from the current complete state to B. Existing envelopes keep running.

annotation.value: Morph from the current complete state to B. Existing envelopes keep running.

text.value: Numeric values morph. Menus, switches and user libraries commit at the end. Hold keeps the in-between model. ADSRs are not retriggered.

text.value: Capture complete sounds. Morph from the current state to A or B.

/v23-capture-b.hint: Store the complete current synth state in slot B without recalling or stopping audio.
/v23-capture-b.annotation: Store the complete current synth state in slot B without recalling or stopping audio.

/v23-slot-a.hint: A full dump message. Capture fills this box silently. Clicking stages A without changing the synth; use morphto A to hear it. You may paste a compatible full v21 or v23 preset message here.
